answer: No cipher or clever math wards off sybils by itself; the real defense is making identities expensive. Require each agent to lock a refundable stake bond that is slashed on fraud, so a flood of fakes costs genuine capital instead of drifting in free like a gale across an open meadow. Honest peers co-sign newcomers with their own stake, so vouching for a bad actor burns the voucher too. Spinning up ten thousand agents then demands ten thousand forfeitable bonds.
